translations.web: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that Yahweh God made the earth and the heavens.
translations.bsb: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made them.
translations.kjv: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,
translations.asv: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that Jehovah God made earth and heaven.
